15967:   function addSimulationToLibrary(){
15968:     if(!state.simResult || !state.simResult.dataUrl) return;
15969:     const KEY='caseflow_project_library_v55';
15970:     state.projectLibrary = Array.isArray(state.projectLibrary) ? state.projectLibrary : getStore();
15971:     // Prefer promoting the existing compressed auto-save record to permanent,
15972:     // rather than storing a new full-resolution record that would overflow localStorage.
15973:     const autoId = state.simResult.__autoId;
15974:     if(autoId){
15975:       const ex = state.projectLibrary.find(r=>r && r.id===autoId);
15976:       if(ex){
15977:         ex.temp=false; delete ex.expiresAt;
15978:         ex.title='Simulation Reference Image';
15979:         if(typeof window.cfPersistLib==='function') window.cfPersistLib(KEY, state.projectLibrary); else setStore(state.projectLibrary);

15994:     const id='sim_' + Date.now();

28815:     window.cfDrawMorphFrame=async function(canvas, t, options){
28816:       var plan=state.morphEventPlan;
28817:       /* Rollback switch (§legacy fallback): window.CF_DISABLE_EVENT_MORPH=true
28818:          restores the previous stable renderer without removing the feature.
28819:          t always comes from the caller — the phase remap derives from it and
28820:          still progresses 0→1; it is never frozen to a constant. */
28821:       if(window.CF_DISABLE_EVENT_MORPH || !plan || !plan.confirmed) return core(canvas, t, options);
28822:       var ph=planPhases(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t)), plan);
28823:       var out=await core(canvas, ph.warpT, options);
28824:       try{
28825:         var photos=(typeof window.cfGetMorphSource==='function')?window.cfGetMorphSource():((state&&state.photos)||[]);
28826:         var aIdx=(options&&options.aIndex)||0;
28827:         applyMaskOps(canvas, photos[aIdx], ph.ops);
28828:       }catch(e){ /* mask pass must never break the frame */ }
28829:       return out;
28830:     };
28831:   }

28834:   setTimeout(installWrap, 1500);

28851:   /* ---- AI analysis call (server-side Gemini; key never in frontend) ---- */
28852:   function downscale(dataUrl, maxDim){
28853:     return new Promise(function(resolve){
28854:       var im=new Image();
28855:       im.onload=function(){
28856:         var s=Math.min(1, maxDim/Math.max(im.naturalWidth, im.naturalHeight));
28857:         var c=document.createElement('canvas');
28858:         c.width=Math.max(2,Math.round(im.naturalWidth*s)); c.height=Math.max(2,Math.round(im.naturalHeight*s));
28859:         c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);
28860:         try{ resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.85)); }catch(e){ resolve(dataUrl); }
28861:       };
28862:       im.onerror=function(){ resolve(dataUrl); };
28863:       im.src=dataUrl;
28864:     });
28865:   }

28025:     var v=entry[code]; if(v==null) v=entry.en; if(v==null) continue;
28026:     if(el.innerHTML!==v) el.innerHTML=v;
28027:   }
28028: }
28029: function applyNav(code){

28034:       if(nodes[j].nodeType===3 && nodes[j].nodeValue.replace(/\s+/g,'')!==''){ node=nodes[j]; break; }
28035:     }
28036:     if(!node) continue;

28127: /* ——— nav survives later rewrites (Sim → Account swap etc.) ——— */
28128: function observeNav(){
28129:   var bar=document.querySelector('.bottom');
28130:   if(!bar || bar.__cfLangObs) return;
28131:   bar.__cfLangObs=true;
28132:   new MutationObserver(function(){ applyNav(getLang()); }).observe(bar,{childList:true,subtree:true});
28133: }

28135: /* ——— quiet poem line under the wait spinner ——— */
28136: function installPoems(){
28137:   var w=window.cfWait;
28138:   if(!w || w.__cfPoem) return;
28139:   w.__cfPoem=true;
28140:   var timer=null, idx=0;
28141:   function el(){
28142:     var card=document.querySelector('.cfWaitOverlay .cfWaitCard');
28143:     if(!card) return null;
28144:     var p=card.querySelector('.cfWaitPoem');
28145:     if(!p){ p=document.createElement('div'); p.className='cfWaitPoem'; card.appendChild(p); }
28146:     return p;
28147:   }
28148:   function tick(){
28149:     var p=el(); if(!p) return;
28150:     var ph=POEMS[idx%POEMS.length]; idx++;
28151:     var loc=ph[getLang()]||ph.en;
28152:     p.innerHTML=(loc===ph.en)?ph.en:(ph.en+'<br>'+loc);
28153:   }
28154:   function stopIfHidden(){
28155:     setTimeout(function(){
28156:       var o=document.querySelector('.cfWaitOverlay');
28157:       if((!o || !o.classList.contains('show')) && timer){ clearInterval(timer); timer=null; }
28158:     },80);
28159:   }
28160:   var _show=w.show, _hide=w.hide, _hideAll=w.hideAll;
28161:   w.show=function(msg,delay){
28162:     _show(msg,delay);
28163:     if(!timer){ idx=0; tick(); timer=setInterval(tick,3400); }
28164:   };
28165:   w.hide=function(){ _hide(); stopIfHidden(); };
28166:   w.hideAll=function(){ _hideAll(); stopIfHidden(); };
28167: }
28168: 
28169: function boot(){
28170:   ensureButtons();
28171:   observeNav();
28172:   installPoems();
28173:   apply(getLang());
28174: }
28175: if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);
28176: else boot();
28177: window.cfI18n={ t:t, get:getLang, set:apply, langs:LANGS };
28178: })();
28179: </script>

28181: <!-- ============ Safe-area / PWA responsive fit (home card, landscape cards, floating controls) ============ -->
28182: <script>
28183: /* --real-vh = 実際に見えている高さの 1%（Safari の下部バー表示/非表示や PWA で
28184:    一致させるため visualViewport.height を使う）。ホーム artboard の比例配置に使用。 */
28185: (function(){
28186:   function upd(){
28187:     try{
28188:       var vv=window.visualViewport;
28189:       var h=(vv&&vv.height)?vv.height:window.innerHeight;
28190:       if(h>0) document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--real-vh',(h*0.01)+'px');
28191:     }catch(e){}
28192:   }
28193:   upd();
28194:   addEventListener('resize',upd);
